data_point: Publishes ARR, customer count or growth milestones
run_when: Code found a possible metric that needs confirming.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company publishes its own ARR, revenue, customer count or growth milestones.
prompt.definition: Real revenue milestones show the transaction volume Puzzle needs.
yes_when: '$5M ARR', '7,000+ companies use us', 'grew 3x this year' about the company itself
no_when: Not applicable; use unknown when nothing is published
unknown_when: No numbers about the company itself
watch_out_for: Numbers about the market or about customers' results don't count
Social media follower counts don't count

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" ARR OR revenue OR customers growth

examples.input_excerpt: Over 7,000 companies trust Puzzle with their books

output.reason: The company publishes its customer count.
